dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。まず、お名前と、性別、年齢を教えていただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. First, could you please tell me your name, gender, and age?

dialogue.content: はい、レクともうします。お願いいたします男です。45才です。
dialogue.English: Yes, my name is Reku. I'm a man, and I'm 45 years old. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。レクさんですね。今日ははどうされましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, Reku, right? What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: はい、3年前、大学を卒業以来20年近く働いてきました。
dialogue.English: Yes. Three years ago, I had been working for nearly 20 years since graduating from university.

dialogue.content: その会社をリストラされてしまいました。
dialogue.English: I was laid off from that company.

dialogue.content: 家族は専業主婦の妻と。小学生の子供2人で
dialogue.English: My family consists of my wife, who is a full-time homemaker, and our two elementary-school-aged children.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: これからますますお金が必要になる時期を迎えます。
dialogue.English: We're heading into a period where we're going to need more and more money.

dialogue.content: 突然のリストラにあい途方に暮れています。
dialogue.English: This sudden layoff has left me at a complete loss.

dialogue.content: そうだったんのですね、、、。長年働いていた会社からリストラされ、
dialogue.English: I see... Being laid off from a company where you worked for so many years...

dialogue.content: 家族もいる中、子供さんも大きくなりますし、それはお辛いですね、、
dialogue.English: ...and with a family and growing children, that must be incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: 最愛の妻にも、心配をかけたくないので、まだリストラされたことを、告げていません。
dialogue.English: I don't want to worry my beloved wife, so I haven't told her about the layoff yet.

dialogue.content: コロナで、仕事も見つからないし
dialogue.English: And because of COVID, I can't find a job,

dialogue.content: 子供も小さいし
dialogue.English: and my children are still young.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナの影響も大きいですよね。
dialogue.English: The impact of COVID has been huge, hasn't it?

dialogue.content: 一人で、悩みを抱えてつらいので、今は、自ら命をたつこと考えています。
dialogue.English: It's so painful carrying this burden alone... right now, I'm thinking about taking my own life.

dialogue.content: 先が見えません。
dialogue.English: I can't see any way forward.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、、。1人で奥様にも言えない中、お一人で悩まれて苦しいですね。
dialogue.English: I understand... It must be agonizing to be struggling with this all on your own, unable to even tell your wife.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 命を立つこともお考えになられている中、ここに相談に来てくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in to talk, especially while you've been having thoughts of ending your life.

dialogue.content: レクさんがお辛い現状から、少しでも楽になれる方法を一緒に考えたいと思っております。
dialogue.English: I would like to think together with you about ways for you to find even a little relief from this difficult situation.

dialogue.content: 誰かに、このつらい気持ちを聞いて欲しくて
dialogue.English: I just wanted someone to listen to how painful this is for me.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 思いもよらないことが起きて、
dialogue.English: When something so unexpected happens...

dialogue.content: 目の前が何も見えなくなってしまうのは、苦しいですし、
dialogue.English: ...it's agonizing to feel like you can't see anything ahead of you,

dialogue.content: はい、全然想像もしていませんでした。
dialogue.English: Yes, I never imagined this would happen at all.

dialogue.content: いきなり告げられたのですか？
dialogue.English: Were you told all of a sudden?

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは驚きますよね、、、
dialogue.English: That must have been a huge shock...

dialogue.content: 何も考えられなくなって当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you wouldn't be able to think straight.

dialogue.content: 上層部の何人かはわかっていたようです
dialogue.English: It seems like some people in upper management knew about it.

dialogue.content: 上層部の中で、話し合いがなされたのですね
dialogue.English: So it was something that was discussed among the higher-ups, then.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。これから、マイホームを建てようと話して板や先でした。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. And this happened right when we were talking about building our own home.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。将来のプランを考えられていたばかりだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you had just been making plans for the future.

dialogue.content: はい、子供たちと一緒に設計図を書いて居ました
dialogue.English: Yes, we were even drawing up floor plans together with the children.

dialogue.content: すでに具体的に進んでらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: So you were already making concrete progress on that.

dialogue.content: まだ、これからです。仕事を職安で探しても今はないですと断られました。
dialogue.English: Well, we were just about to start. I've looked for work at the public employment office, but they turned me away saying there's nothing available right now.

dialogue.content: そうですか。求人全くない状況ですか、、、
dialogue.English: I see. So there are absolutely no job openings...

dialogue.content: 不安になりますね
dialogue.English: That must be unnerving.

dialogue.content: 職安以外には何かみられましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you looked anywhere else besides the public employment office?

dialogue.content: 広告など、探していますが、パートで、週に3日位の仕事しかないので、困っています
dialogue.English: I've been looking at advertisements and such, but I'm having trouble because there are only part-time jobs for about three days a week.

dialogue.content: 確かにパートは厳しいですよね、、、。
dialogue.English: Yes, surviving on part-time work would be difficult, wouldn't it...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 転職サイトなどは活用されてみましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you tried using any job-search websites?

dialogue.content: 今はどこも同じような感じです。コロナで、職を無くした方が、沢山きているので、
dialogue.English: It seems to be the same everywhere right now. So many people who lost their jobs because of COVID are looking for work.

dialogue.content: 確かに、コロナの影響は大きいですよね、、、。
dialogue.English: That's true, the impact of COVID is enormous...

dialogue.content: はい、明日からどうしよと、一人で、悩んでいます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm struggling alone, wondering what to do starting tomorrow.

dialogue.content: 妻に話したらきっと離婚されます
dialogue.English: If I tell my wife, I'm sure she'll divorce me.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、奥様にも言えないとおっしゃっておりましたね、、
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you feel you can't tell your wife...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしてそのように思われるのですか？
dialogue.English: Why do you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 話したら、離婚になり、子供たちとも離ればなれになると思うと言えません
dialogue.English: I can't bring myself to tell her because I think we'll get divorced and I'll be separated from my children.

dialogue.content: 妻に、つらいおもいをかけたくないし
dialogue.English: And I don't want to cause my wife any pain.

dialogue.content: 子供さんと離れるのは避けたいですよね。しかし、離婚という選択肢、、、何か心当たりはあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Of course, you want to avoid being separated from your children. But as for divorce... is there a particular reason you think that might happen?

dialogue.content: 奥様のことも子供さまのことも大事に考えておられるのですね、、、
dialogue.English: It sounds like you care very deeply for both your wife and your children...

dialogue.content: きっと、リストラになると、安定した生活が出来なくなり、りこんして実家に戻りますと、言われそうです
dialogue.English: I'm sure that once she finds out I've been laid off and we can't have a stable life anymore, she's going to say she'll divorce me and go back to her parents' house.

dialogue.content: 確かに、収入が減ることは大きなダメージに繋がることと思います、、、
dialogue.English: I agree that a loss of income would be a major blow...

dialogue.content: しかし、本当に奥様はそのようにお考えなのでしょうか、、、？
dialogue.English: But do you really think your wife would feel that way...?

dialogue.content: まさか、想像も、していなかたので、かなり、大変になります
dialogue.English: I never in a million years imagined this, so things are going to be incredibly difficult.

dialogue.content: 生活が変わりますよね、、レクさんは家族を裏切ったり、悪いことをして来た訳でもありません、、、
dialogue.English: Your life is going to change, yes... But it's not as if you've done anything wrong or betrayed your family...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: レクさんは今まで家族のためにと20年もお仕事を頑張って来たんですよね、、。それは本当に素晴らしいことだと思います。
dialogue.English: You've worked hard for your family for 20 years, haven't you? I think that's a truly wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんなレクさんのこと、レクさんが大事に思っているくらい、奥様も大事に思われているのではないでしょうか、、、？
dialogue.English: And for a person like you... don't you think that your wife cares for you just as much as you care for her?

dialogue.content: そうですかね？
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: そう思いませんか、、？
dialogue.English: Don't you think so...?

dialogue.content: マイホームも考えられて、すごく仲の良い、いい家庭をおもちだと、私は感じています。
dialogue.English: You were planning to build a home together... I get the feeling you have a wonderful, close-knit family.

dialogue.content: リストラの事を伝えたら、きっと気が動転してしまいますよ！
dialogue.English: If I tell her about the layoff, she'll surely be distraught!

dialogue.content: 確かに、最初は驚くことと思います。しかし、世間的にみても状況が状況です、、、
dialogue.English: She would certainly be shocked at first, I'm sure. But given the way things are in the world right now...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: レクさんのせいではないです、、、
dialogue.English: This isn't your fault...

dialogue.content: そうですかね
dialogue.English: Do you really think so?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とりあえずは、収入を確保しないといけませんよね。
dialogue.English: For the time being, the priority is to secure some income, right?

dialogue.content: 会社に何の不安も感じなかったので、まさかとわたしが動転してしまいました
dialogue.English: I never felt any insecurity about the company, so I was the one who was completely floored, thinking it couldn't be happening.

dialogue.content: コロナでなければ仕事も見つかりそうですが
dialogue.English: If it weren't for COVID, I think I'd be able to find a job, but...

dialogue.content: 20年も働かれておられたのですし、それはびっくりしますよね。失業手当についてはご存知でしょうか？
dialogue.English: You worked there for 20 years; of course you'd be shocked. Are you familiar with unemployment benefits?

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 会社の都合により、解雇された場合は7日後に支給されます。とりあえずは、失業手当を受けてみるお考えはありますか？
dialogue.English: If you were laid off for reasons on the company's end, payments can begin after a 7-day waiting period. For the time being, have you considered receiving those benefits?

dialogue.content: 辛くてそこまでは考えられませんでした
dialogue.English: It's been too painful, I couldn't even think that far.

dialogue.content: それくらいしんどい思いをされていたのですもんね、、、
dialogue.English: That just shows how much you've been suffering...

dialogue.content: はい、明日早速行って見ます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll go and look into it first thing tomorrow.

dialogue.content: 失業手当の受給期間は1年です。お近くのハローワークで手続きできます。
dialogue.English: The benefit period for unemployment is one year. You can complete the procedures at your local Hello Work office.

dialogue.content: 一年間頂けますか！
dialogue.English: I can receive them for a whole year?!

dialogue.content: 相談して良かったです。
dialogue.English: I'm so glad I came to talk to you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです！意外と長いですよね！はい。ぜひ手続きしてみてください。提出書類が諸々ありますので、最寄りのハローワークのホームページでご確認してみてくださいね！
dialogue.English: That's right! It's surprisingly long, isn't it? Yes, please do go and apply. There are several documents you'll need to submit, so be sure to check the website for your nearest Hello Work office!

dialogue.content: そう言っていただけて嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい、分かりました。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、色々とお話を聞かせていただきありがとうございます。また、何かお困りごとがございましたら、いつでもご相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing so much with me. If anything else comes up that you're struggling with, please don't hesitate to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、分かりました
dialogue.English: Okay, I will.

dialogue.content: ではこれで終了させていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we conclude our session for today, then?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 終了いたします。
dialogue.English: I will now end the session.
